g.text: Synthetic illustration | Loans are fully disbursed at t=0; equal annual principal after any principal-payment holiday
FX shock: local-currency price of USD rises 25% from year 6. Combined stress also lowers the nominal envelope 20%.
The envelope is synthetic, not government revenue. Grant repayments are zero under every scenario. No debt-sustainability threshold is estimated.
